fact_text: Maple Leaf's net sales rose 15% to PKR 18.9 billion in the quarter, driven by higher local dispatches, while exports dipped on the Afghanistan issue.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: Maple Leaf's gross margin rose 1 percentage point to 35%, helped by higher retention prices and better local dispatches, while administrative expenses rose 36% quarter on quarter to PKR 72 million.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: The host said the rise in admin expenses of 30-38% was not fully explained, could be partly one-off, and might ease in later quarters.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: Cement dispatches fell in January and February 2026 because of Ramadan and the winter season, which the host flagged as a seasonal drag on cement earnings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: Coal averaged about $86 per ton in the December quarter, the host said, the cost base against which Maple Leaf's quarterly earnings were measured.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: Coal averaged about $97 per ton across February and March 2026, up from about $86 in the December quarter, as the host explained, after the US-Iran conflict pushed prices up.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: If coal stayed at about $100 per ton, the host estimated the hit to Maple Leaf's annual earnings at about 10%, though old inventory could cushion it.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: Maple Leaf has completed its acquisition of Pioneer Cement, with a total price of about PKR 70 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: If 70% of the PKR 70 billion Pioneer price is debt-funded, debt would be about PKR 50 billion, with finance costs of roughly PKR 5-6 billion weighing on earnings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: On assumed earnings of about PKR 10 per share, Maple Leaf traded near 8 times earnings, and near 6.5-7 times cash earnings after adding back about PKR 4 of depreciation.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: Maple Leaf's share price was about 35% below its peak, against about 20% for the PSX, which the host read as heavy underperformance.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: UBL announced a PKR 8 dividend with its fourth-quarter results, in line with the host's expectations.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: UBL's net interest income rose 2.3% quarter on quarter to PKR 94.1 billion, while operating expenses rose 34% quarter on quarter to PKR 43.6 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: UBL's deposits grew about 95-96% year on year, against roughly 25-27% for the banking industry, and rose about 16% quarter on quarter.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: Industry deposit growth was about 25-27%, so UBL's near-96% growth was unprecedented in the host's experience and raises the question of whether it can continue.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: UBL's operating expenses rose on branch expansion, higher deposits and centralisation costs, and the host expected them to normalise in Q1 CY2026 as year-end bonuses drop out.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: Core net interest income grew about 2-3%, the host said, because lower yields on OMO borrowings cut UBL's cost of funds, while non-funded income was broadly flat.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: The host said UBL's results were well below expectations, mainly because of high operating expenses, though a normalising cost base could help later earnings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: UBL's provisioning was on the high side, but its coverage ratio is above 100%, which the host said means the provisions are covered.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: At about PKR 400 a share, UBL traded near 7 times forward earnings on the host's estimate of about PKR 60 CY2026 earnings, with a 7-8% dividend yield.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: UBL's book value per share was about PKR 200, so the stock traded near 2 times book; the host cited a sustainable ROE of about 25% and 13-14% growth in recent years.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: If UBL's growth reaches 30-40%, the host said the earnings upside from the stock's level would be large, though the shape of that growth still needs to be watched.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: UBL had traded above PKR 500 before the market correction that followed its peak, and the host noted a large fall from that level.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: The host said earnings visibility is relatively higher for banks than for other sectors, because bank earnings track deposits and lending more predictably.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: GCIL earned PKR 1.22 per share in its second quarter, up 31% quarter on quarter, and net sales rose 9% quarter on quarter to about PKR 2 billion.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: GCIL's gross margin rose 6 percentage points to 48%, and distribution costs rose 21% quarter on quarter to PKR 1,160.8 million, with an effective tax rate of about 10%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: GCIL runs about five plants in Lahore, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa and Sindh, the host said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: GCIL's newest and largest plant, rated at 275 tons per day, came online in April 2025 and the host described it as about 25% more efficient than the older plants.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: The host attributed the margin gain mainly to higher utilisation of the new plant, and said the effective tax rate fell to 10% from 11% because operations were concentrated there.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: GCIL's share count rose to about 570 million from about 500 million, so per-share comparisons across years must use the adjusted share count.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: In January 2026 GCIL announced a new project to produce food-grade CO2 and LNG, and its subsidiary holds OGRA approval to distribute LPG.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: GCIL supplies medical and industrial gases to food, non-food and energy-sector customers, so its volumes move with industrial activity, the host said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)

fact_text: At about PKR 28.50 a share, GCIL traded near 5 times earnings on the host's view that CY2026 earnings could reach PKR 5.5-6 per share.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Corporate Earnings of MLCF, UBL, and GCIL | Stock Watch | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-03-04)
